title: 12 Geniuses E188 — Eric on why Costco endures: 'a prescient founder in Jim Sinegal who protected the company from external financial pressures'
summary: Don MacPherson hosts Eric on 12 Geniuses episode 188 to unpack Costco's 40-year run — attributing its endurance to Jim Sinegal's foresight in building governance structures that shielded the company from external financial pressures.
blockquote: Eric Ries, author of 'Incorruptible,' explains why Costco can attribute its success to a prescient founder in Jim Sinegal who protected the company from external financial pressures.
